shown.means: the chapter the player is at (0 the prologue … 5 the epilogue): the view goes to its point c<i> (camera_x)

come.means: each new value brings the view back to the chapter shown (camera_x), the player's drag with it

route.means: how far the red line of the way has come: 0 London … 0.04 Brindisi, 0.07 Suez, 0.14 Bombay, 0.22 Calcutta, 0.33 Hong Kong, 0.4 Yokohama, 0.55 San Francisco, 0.78 New York, 0.97 Liverpool, 1 London

dateline.means: the day won from the sun: the 180th meridian in red ink, a notch across the way, «+1 day»

objects.name: The old map of the world

prompts.text: Light orchestral travel music in the Victorian manner, strings and woodwinds, a red line drawn across an old map of the world
Sparse solo piano in a large quiet room, slow single notes falling like the tick of a clock, warm hall reverb, late evening, restrained and precise
Pizzicato strings ticking in strict tempo like clockwork, light chamber orchestra, curious, poised, understated anticipation
Soft sustained low strings and a distant fog-like drone, minimalist ambient, deep space and stillness
Celesta and harp in delicate interlocking arpeggios, music-box precision, quiet wonder
Minimalist repeating piano patterns in the manner of modern indie game scores, cool and luminous, slowly evolving
Solo cello, long bowed notes, melancholic and dignified, gaslit London night
Light orchestral adventure theme, brisk strings and woodwinds in the rhythm of a steam train, 1870s optimism
Muted marimba and woodblock ticking against a metronome, playful clockwork, dry and close
String quartet playing a slow aristocratic waltz in a gentlemen's club, muted, far away behind closed doors
Cold ambient synth pads and soft noise like fog against glass, modern atmospheric game soundtrack
Distant brass chorale, solemn and warm, heard through fog across a city square
Harpsichord and bassoon in crisp baroque counterpoint, exact, a little ironic
Low timpani pulse like a slow heartbeat under thin high strings, tension of a countdown
Glass harmonica and bowed vibraphone shimmering, ethereal, suspended time
Clarinet melody over soft pizzicato bass, gentle wit, Victorian parlour
Warm crackling-fire mood: felt piano, soft upright bass, slow and intimate
Full orchestra swelling to a bright triumphant arrival, horns and strings, the door flung open
Solo music box slowing down, a mechanism winding to a stop, fragile
Accordion and strings, faint street music from outside, a waiting crowd in the fog
